## Summary

Describe the purpose and affected Match, Order, protocol, game-flow, Unity metadata, documentation, or site components.

## Validation

- [ ] I recorded the build or test environment and commands.
- [ ] I added or updated tests where a runnable harness exists.
- [ ] I checked compatibility, configuration, database, and rollback impact.
- [ ] I did not commit secrets, private endpoints, personal data, generated dependencies, binaries, logs, or caches.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute all included code and media.
- [ ] I updated documentation and the changelog when behavior changed.

## Evidence

Provide sanitized logs, screenshots, test results, or a minimal reproduction.
